title: Data Professional Survey Dashboard
description: A Power BI dashboard exploring compensation, tools and career satisfaction across a survey of 630 data professionals.
problem: What patterns in roles, compensation and career satisfaction appear in a data-professional survey?
approach: Presented geographic distribution, salary by role, tool preferences and satisfaction measures in an interactive dashboard.
outcome: A visual summary that lets viewers compare the survey responses. A recorded walkthrough is available.
limitations: A self-reported survey reflects its respondents and sampling limits. It is not a representative salary benchmark for every market.
